mission.posting: Bit, a well regarded member of CSEC, and a personal friend of many people here dropped off grid over 2 weeks ago, and hasn't made contact with anyone. While numerous private investigations are no doubt underway, I'd like to make this an official CSEC posting for anyone that wants to help. We're looking for any information we can get regarding his disappearance, or, ideally, current state.

email.subject: Bit's disappearance Investigation
email.body:
Hey,
This'll be a less formal email, and I'm going to sign it with my handle, no need for anonymity here, we're looking out for a friend. So Bit went dark a little over 2 weeks ago which is pretty unusual. I mean, going dark for a bit is fine, but not contacting anyone here? 2 weeks? Something's up.
I've thrown in a few links to some servers he owns/uses, so maybe dig around there. If you find anything, throw it up on the CSEC drop server and I'll check it out.
Thanks, -Vapor
